rawAnswer: {"story":{"what":"TypeCollector now sends every analyzer diagnostic through a filter, ReportIfLocatedInCompilation. The filter drops any diagnostic whose location is not a source location in a syntax tree of the compilation being analyzed. Two diagnostic sites used to index DeclaringSyntaxReferences[0] directly. They now use FirstOrDefault or a null-safe helper, so a member that exists only in metadata no longer throws. The change also adds three tests that use a metadata-only referenced assembly, docs in the README and in MsgPack004.md, and an unrelated edit that sets MessagePackSecurity.UntrustedData.HashCollisionResistant to false.","why":"When a [MessagePackObject] member's type is a closed generic struct from a referenced assembly, the collector looks at that type's members, which have no syntax references.
